SCNAction.doc: A simple, reusable animation that changes attributes of any node you attach it to.

SCNAnimationEvent.doc: A container for a closure, a block in Objective-C, to be executed at a specific time during playback of an animation.

SCNAudioPlayer.doc: A controller for playback of a positional audio source in a SceneKit scene.

SCNAudioSource.doc: A simple, reusable audio source—music or sound effects loaded from a file—for use in positional audio playback.

SCNBillboardConstraint.doc: A constraint that orients a node to always point toward the current camera.

SCNBox.doc: A six-sided polyhedron geometry whose faces are all rectangles, optionally with rounded edges and corners.

SCNCamera.doc: A set of camera attributes that can be attached to a node to provide a point of view for displaying the scene.

SCNCapsule.doc: A right circular cylinder geometry whose ends are capped with hemispheres.

SCNCone.doc: A right circular cone or frustum geometry.

SCNConstraint.doc: The abstract superclass for objects that automatically adjust the position, rotation, or scale of a node based on specified rules.

SCNFloor.doc: A plane that can optionally display a reflection of the scene above it.

SCNGeometry.doc: A three-dimensional shape (also called a model or mesh) that can be displayed in a scene, with attached materials that define its appearance.

SCNGeometryElement.doc: A container for index data describing how vertices connect to define a three-dimensional object, or geometry.

SCNGeometrySource.doc: A container for vertex data forming part of the definition for a three-dimensional object, or geometry.

SCNHitTestResult.doc: Information about the result of a scene-space or view-space search for scene elements.

SCNIKConstraint.doc: A constraint that applies inverse kinematics to make a chain of nodes “reach” toward a target point.

SCNLayer.doc: A Core Animation layer that renders a SceneKit scene as its content.

SCNLevelOfDetail.doc: An alternate resolution for a geometry that SceneKit automatically substitutes to improve rendering performance.

SCNLight.doc: A light source that can be attached to a node to illuminate the scene.

SCNLookAtConstraint.doc: A constraint that orients a node to always point toward a specified other node.

SCNMaterial.doc: A set of shading attributes that define the appearance of a geometry’s surface when rendered.

SCNMaterialProperty.doc: A container for the color or texture of one of a material’s visual properties.

SCNMorpher.doc: An object that manages smooth transitions between a node’s base geometry and one or more target geometries.

SCNNode.doc: A structural element of a scene graph, representing a position and transform in a 3D coordinate space, to which you can attach geometry, lights, cameras, or other displayable content.

SCNParticlePropertyController.doc: An animation for a single property of the individual particles rendered by a particle system.

SCNParticleSystem.doc: An object that animates and renders a system of small image sprites using a high-level simulation whose general behavior you specify.

SCNPhysicsBallSocketJoint.doc: A physics behavior that connects two physics bodies and allows them to pivot around each other in any direction.

SCNPhysicsBehavior.doc: The abstract superclass for joints, vehicle simulations, and other high-level behaviors that incorporate multiple physics bodies.

SCNPhysicsBody.doc: The physics simulation attributes attached to a scene graph node.

SCNPhysicsContact.doc: Detailed information about a contact between two physics bodies in a scene’s physics simulation.

SCNPhysicsField.doc: An object that applies forces, such as gravitation, electromagnetism, and turbulence, to physics bodies within a certain area of effect.

SCNPhysicsHingeJoint.doc: A physics behavior that connects two bodies and allows them to pivot around each other on a single axis.

SCNPhysicsShape.doc: An abstraction of a physics body’s solid volume for tuning collision detection.

SCNPhysicsSliderJoint.doc: A physics behavior that connects two bodies and allows them to slide against each other and rotate around their connecting points.

SCNPhysicsVehicle.doc: A physics behavior that modifies a physics body to behave like a car, motorcycle, or other wheeled vehicle.

SCNPhysicsVehicleWheel.doc: The appearance and physical characteristics of an individual wheel associated with an physics vehicle behavior.

SCNPhysicsWorld.doc: The global simulation of collisions, gravity, joints, and other physics effects in a scene.

SCNPlane.doc: A rectangular, one-sided plane geometry of specified width and height.

SCNProgram.doc: A complete Metal or OpenGL shader program that replaces SceneKit’s rendering of a geometry or material.

SCNReferenceNode.doc: A scene graph node that serves as a placeholder for content to be loaded from a separate scene file.

SCNRenderer.doc: A renderer for displaying a SceneKit scene in an existing Metal workflow or OpenGL context.

SCNScene.doc: A container for the node hierarchy and global properties that together form a displayable 3D scene.

SCNSceneSource.doc: An object that manages the data-reading tasks associated with loading scene contents from a file or data.

SCNShape.doc: A geometry based on a two-dimensional path, optionally extruded to create a three-dimensional object.

SCNSkinner.doc: An object that manages the relationship between skeletal animations and the nodes and geometries they animate.

SCNSphere.doc: A sphere (or ball or globe) geometry.

SCNTechnique.doc: A specification for augmenting or postprocessing SceneKit’s rendering of a scene using additional drawing passes with custom Metal or OpenGL shaders.

SCNText.doc: A geometry based on a string of text, optionally extruded to create a three-dimensional object.

SCNTransaction.doc: A mechanism for creating implicit animations and combining scene graph changes into atomic updates.

SCNTransformConstraint.doc: A constraint that runs a specified closure, block in Objective-C, to compute a new transform (position, rotation, and scale) for each node that the constraint affects.

SCNTube.doc: A tube or pipe geometry—a right circular cylinder with a circular hole along its central axis.

SCNView.doc: A view for displaying 3D SceneKit content.

SCNActionable.doc: Methods for running actions on nodes.

SCNAnimatable.doc: The common interface for attaching animations to nodes, geometries, materials, and other SceneKit objects.

SCNBoundingVolume.doc: Methods common to the SCNNode and SCNGeometry classes for measuring location and size.

SCNBufferStream.doc: An object that manages a Metal buffer used by a custom shader program.

SCNCameraControlConfiguration.doc: Properties affecting the behavior of a camera controller.

SCNNodeRendererDelegate.doc: Methods you can implement to use your own custom Metal or OpenGL drawing code to render content for a node.

SCNPhysicsContactDelegate.doc: Methods you can implement to respond when a contact or collision occurs between two physics bodies in a scene.

SCNProgramDelegate.doc: The interface for tracking errors that occur when compiling shader source code.

SCNSceneExportDelegate.doc: Methods you can implement to participate in the process of exporting a scene to a file.

SCNSceneRenderer.doc: Methods and properties common to the SCNView, SCNLayer, and SCNRenderer classes.

SCNSceneRendererDelegate.doc: Methods your app can implement to participate in SceneKit’s animation loop or perform additional rendering.

SCNShadable.doc: Methods for customizing SceneKit’s rendering of geometry and materials using Metal or OpenGL shader programs.

SCNTechniqueSupport.doc: The common interface for SceneKit objects that support multipass rendering using SCNTechnique objects.

SCNActionTimingMode.doc: Constants affecting the animation curve of an action, used by the timingMode property.

SCNActionTimingModeEaseIn.doc: Ease-in pacing. The animation begins slowly, and then speeds up as it progresses.

SCNActionTimingModeEaseInEaseOut.doc: Ease-in ease-out pacing. The animation begins slowly, accelerates through the middle of its duration, and then slows again before completing.

SCNActionTimingModeEaseOut.doc: Ease-out pacing. The animation begins quickly, and then slows as it completes.

SCNActionTimingModeLinear.doc: Linear pacing. The animation progresses evenly throughout its duration.

SCNAntialiasingMode.doc: Modes for antialiased rendering of the view’s scene, used by the SCNView property.

SCNAntialiasingModeMultisampling16X.doc: Enables multisample antialiasing, with sixteen samples per screen pixel.

SCNAntialiasingModeMultisampling2X.doc: Enables multisample antialiasing, with two samples per screen pixel.

SCNAntialiasingModeMultisampling4X.doc: Enables multisample antialiasing, with four samples per screen pixel.

SCNAntialiasingModeMultisampling8X.doc: Enables multisample antialiasing, with eight samples per screen pixel.

SCNBillboardAxis.doc: Options for locking the orientation of nodes affected by a billboard constraint.

SCNBillboardAxisAll.doc: Align an affected node such that its orientation always matches that of the view.

SCNBillboardAxisX.doc: Align an affected node such that its x-axis is always parallel to that of the view, leaving it free to rotate otherwise.

SCNBillboardAxisY.doc: Align an affected node such that its y-axis is always parallel to that of the view, leaving it free to rotate otherwise.

SCNBillboardAxisZ.doc: Align an affected node such that its z-axis is always perpendicular to the viewing plane, leaving it free to rotate otherwise.

SCNBlendMode.doc: Modes that describe how SceneKit blends source colors rendered using a material with destination colors already in a rendering target, used by the blendMode property.

SCNBlendModeAdd.doc: Blend by adding the source color to the destination color.

SCNBlendModeAlpha.doc: Blend by multiplying source and destination color values by their corresponding alpha values.

SCNBlendModeMultiply.doc: Blend by multiplying the source color with the background color.

SCNBlendModeReplace.doc: Blend by replacing the destination color with the source color, ignoring alpha.

SCNBlendModeScreen.doc: Blend by multiplying the inverse of the source color with the inverse of the destination color.

SCNBlendModeSubtract.doc: Blend by subtracting the source color from the destination color.

SCNBufferFrequency.doc: Options for how often SceneKit should execute the binding handler you provide with the handleBindingOfBufferNamed:frequency:usingBlock: method.

SCNBufferFrequencyPerFrame.doc: Execute the binding handler once for each frame to be rendered using the shader.

SCNBufferFrequencyPerNode.doc: Execute the binding handler once for each frame, for each node to be rendered using the shader.

SCNBufferFrequencyPerShadable.doc: Execute the binding handler once for each frame, for each node, for each material or geometry to be rendered using the shader.

SCNCameraProjectionDirection.doc: Options for the axis used to determine field of view or orthographic projection.

SCNCameraProjectionDirectionHorizontal.doc: The camera’s field of view or orthographic scale are measured horizontally.

SCNCameraProjectionDirectionVertical.doc: The camera’s field of view or orthographic scale are measured vertically.

SCNChamferMode.doc: Options for which edges of an extruded shape are chamfered, used by the chamferMode property.

SCNChamferModeBack.doc: Apply a chamfer to only the back edge of the extruded shape.

SCNChamferModeBoth.doc: Apply a chamfer to both front and back edges of the extruded shape.

SCNChamferModeFront.doc: Apply a chamfer to only the front edge of the extruded shape.

SCNCullMode.doc: The modes SceneKit uses to determine which polygons to render in a surface, used by the cullMode property.

SCNDebugOptions.doc: Options for drawing overlays with SceneKit content that can aid in debugging, used with the debugOptions property.

SCNDebugOptionRenderAsWireframe.doc: Display only wireframe placeholders for geometries in the scene.

SCNDebugOptionShowBoundingBoxes.doc: Display the bounding boxes for any nodes with content.

SCNDebugOptionShowCameras.doc: Display visualizations for nodes in the scene with attached cameras and their fields of view.

SCNDebugOptionShowConstraints.doc: Display visualizations of the constraint objects acting on nodes in the scene.

SCNDebugOptionShowCreases.doc: Display nonsmoothed crease regions for geometries affected by surface subdivision.

SCNDebugOptionShowLightExtents.doc: Display the regions affected by each SCNLight object in the scene.

SCNDebugOptionShowLightInfluences.doc: Display the locations of each SCNLight object in the scene.

SCNDebugOptionShowPhysicsFields.doc: Display the regions affected by each SCNPhysicsField object in the scene.

SCNDebugOptionShowPhysicsShapes.doc: Display the physics shapes for any nodes with attached SCNPhysicsBody objects.

SCNDebugOptionShowSkeletons.doc: Display visualizations of the skeletal animation parameters for relevant geometries.

SCNDebugOptionShowWireframe.doc: Display geometries in the scene with wireframe rendering.

showFeaturePoints.doc: Display a point cloud showing intermediate results of the scene analysis that ARKit uses to track device position.

showWorldOrigin.doc: Display a coordinate axis visualization indicating the position and orientation of the AR world coordinate system.

SCNFilterMode.doc: Texture filtering modes, used by the minificationFilter, magnificationFilter, and mipFilter properties.

SCNFilterModeLinear.doc: Texture filtering sample texels from the neighborhood of the coordinates being sampled and linearly interpolates their colors.

SCNFilterModeNearest.doc: Texture filtering returns the color from only one texel, whose location is nearest to the coordinates being sampled.

SCNGeometryPrimitiveType.doc: The drawing primitive that connects vertices when rendering a geometry element, used by the primitiveType property to specify how SceneKit interprets the geometry element’s data.

SCNGeometryPrimitiveTypeLine.doc: The geometry element’s data is a sequence of line segments, with each line segment described by two new vertices.

SCNGeometryPrimitiveTypePoint.doc: The geometry element’s data is a sequence of unconnected points.

SCNGeometryPrimitiveTypeTriangleStrip.doc: The geometry element’s data is a sequence of triangles, with each triangle described by one new vertex and two vertices from the previous triangle.

SCNGeometryPrimitiveTypeTriangles.doc: The geometry element’s data is a sequence of triangles, with each triangle described by three new vertices.

SCNHitTestSearchMode.doc: Possible values for the SCNHitTestOptionSearchMode option used with hit-testing methods.

SCNHitTestSearchModeAll.doc: The hit test should return all possible results, sorted from nearest to farthest.

SCNHitTestSearchModeAny.doc: The hit test should return only the first object found, regardless of distance.

SCNHitTestSearchModeClosest.doc: The hit test should return only the closes object found.

SCNMorpherCalculationMode.doc: The interpolation formulas for blending between target geometries.

SCNMorpherCalculationModeAdditive.doc: Target weights may take on any value, and weighted contributions for each target are added to the base geometry,

SCNMorpherCalculationModeNormalized.doc: Target weights must be in the range between 0.0 and 1.0, and the contribution of the base geometry to the morphed surface is related to the sum of target weights. This is the default mode.

SCNMovabilityHint.doc: Values that inform SceneKit’s rendering for movement-related effects, used by the movabilityHint property.

SCNMovabilityHintFixed.doc: The node is not expected to move over time.

SCNMovabilityHintMovable.doc: The node is expected to move over time.

SCNNodeFocusBehavior.doc: Options for the focusable states of a SceneKit node.

SCNNodeFocusBehaviorFocusable.doc: Node is focusable and prevents nodes that it visually obscures from becoming focusable.

SCNNodeFocusBehaviorOccluding.doc: Node is not focusable and prevents nodes that it visually obscures from becoming focusable.

SCNParticleBirthDirection.doc: Options for the initial direction of each emitted particle, used by the birthDirection property.

SCNParticleBirthDirectionConstant.doc: The emitting direction is the same for all particles.

SCNParticleBirthDirectionRandom.doc: SceneKit randomizes the emitting direction for each particle.

SCNParticleBirthDirectionSurfaceNormal.doc: The emitting direction for each particle is along the surface normal vector at the point where the particle is emitted.

SCNParticleBirthLocation.doc: Options for the initial location of each emitted particle, used by the birthLocation property.

SCNParticleBirthLocationSurface.doc: New particles can be created at any location on the surface of the emitter shape.

SCNParticleBirthLocationVertex.doc: New particles can be created at only at the locations of the vertices in the emitter shape.

SCNParticleBirthLocationVolume.doc: New particles can be created at any location within the volume of the emitter shape.

SCNParticleBlendMode.doc: Options for combining source and destination pixel colors when compositing particles during rendering, used by the blendMode property.

SCNParticleBlendModeAdditive.doc: The source and destination colors are added together.

SCNParticleBlendModeAlpha.doc: The source and destination colors are blended by multiplying the source alpha value.

SCNParticleBlendModeMultiply.doc: The source color is multiplied by the destination color.

SCNParticleBlendModeReplace.doc: The source color replaces the destination color.

SCNParticleBlendModeScreen.doc: The source color is added to the destination color times the inverted source color.

SCNParticleBlendModeSubtract.doc: The source color is subtracted from the destination color.

SCNParticleEvent.doc: Significant events in the life spans of simulate particles, used by the handleEvent:forProperties:withBlock: method.

SCNParticleEventCollision.doc: Occurs when particles collide with scene geometry.

SCNParticleEventDeath.doc: Occurs when particles reach the end of their life span.

SCNParticleImageSequenceAnimationMode.doc: Options for animating each particle with a sequence of images, used by the imageSequenceAnimationMode property.

SCNParticleImageSequenceAnimationModeAut.doc: After the animation displays all of its images, it plays again in reverse order.

SCNParticleImageSequenceAnimationModeCla.doc: The animation stops after displaying all of its images.

SCNParticleImageSequenceAnimationModeRep.doc: The animation loops after displaying all of its images.

SCNParticleInputMode.doc: Options for the input value of the property controller’s animation, used by the inputMode property.

SCNParticleInputModeOverDistance.doc: The controller’s effect on a particle property is a function of the particle’s distance from the position of a specified node.

SCNParticleInputModeOverLife.doc: The controller’s effect on a particle property is a function of the time since the particle’s birth.

SCNParticleInputModeOverOtherProperty.doc: The controller’s effect on a particle property is a function of another of the particle’s properties.

SCNParticleModifierStage.doc: Stages of SceneKit’s particle simulation process into which you can insert modifier blocks, used by the addModifierForProperties:atStage:withBlock: method.

SCNParticleModifierStagePostCollision.doc: The stage after SceneKit simulates the results of collisions between particles and scene geometry.

SCNParticleModifierStagePostDynamics.doc: The stage after SceneKit simulates the motion of particles.

SCNParticleModifierStagePreCollision.doc: The stage before SceneKit simulates the results of collisions between particles and scene geometry.

SCNParticleModifierStagePreDynamics.doc: The stage before SceneKit simulates the motion of particles.

SCNParticleOrientationMode.doc: Options for restricting the orientation of particles, used by the orientationMode property.

SCNParticleOrientationModeBillboardScree.doc: Each particle’s orientation is always fixed with respect to the point of view camera.

SCNParticleOrientationModeBillboardViewA.doc: Each particle always faces the point of view camera (but may rotate about an axis parallel to the view direction).

SCNParticleOrientationModeBillboardYAlig.doc: The y-axis direction of each particle is always fixed with respect to the point of view camera.

SCNParticleOrientationModeFree.doc: Particle orientations are not restricted; they may rotate freely in all axes.

SCNParticleSortingMode.doc: Options for the rendering order of particles, used by the sortingMode property.

SCNParticleSortingModeDistance.doc: Particles farther from the point of view (as measured using distance from the camera in scene space) are rendered before closer particles.

SCNParticleSortingModeNone.doc: Particles are not sorted; they may be rendered in any order.

SCNParticleSortingModeOldestFirst.doc: Particles emitted earlier are rendered before particles emitted more recently.

SCNParticleSortingModeProjectedDepth.doc: Particles farther from the point of view (as measured using projected depth) are rendered before closer particles.

SCNParticleSortingModeYoungestFirst.doc: Particles emitted more recently are rendered before particles emitted earlier.

SCNPhysicsBodyType.doc: Constants that determine how a physics body interacts with forces and other bodies, used by the type property and when creating a physics body.

SCNPhysicsBodyTypeDynamic.doc: A physics body that can be affected by forces and collisions.

SCNPhysicsBodyTypeKinematic.doc: A physics body that is unaffected by forces or collisions but that can cause collisions affecting other bodies when moved.

SCNPhysicsBodyTypeStatic.doc: A physics body that is unaffected by forces or collisions and cannot move.

SCNPhysicsCollisionCategory.doc: Default values for a physics body’s categoryBitMask and collisionBitMask properties.

SCNPhysicsCollisionCategoryAll.doc: This is the default value for a physics body’s collisionBitMask property.

SCNPhysicsCollisionCategoryDefault.doc: The default categoryBitMask value for dynamic and kinematic bodies.

SCNPhysicsCollisionCategoryStatic.doc: The default categoryBitMask value for static bodies.

SCNPhysicsFieldScope.doc: Options for defining the region of space affected by a physics field, used by the scope property.

SCNPhysicsFieldScopeInsideExtent.doc: The field’s effect applies only to objects within the region of space defined by its position and extent.

SCNPhysicsFieldScopeOutsideExtent.doc: The field’s effect applies only to objects outside the region of space defined by its position and extent.

SCNReferenceLoadingPolicy.doc: Options for when to load the reference node’s content, used by the loadingPolicy property.

SCNReferenceLoadingPolicyImmediate.doc: Load the node’s external content immediately when the reference node is unarchived.

SCNReferenceLoadingPolicyOnDemand.doc: Load the node’s external comment only when the load method is called.

SCNRenderingAPI.doc: Options for choosing the graphics technology for an SCNView object (or other SceneKit renderer) to use for drawing its contents. Used by the renderingAPI property and the SCNPreferredRenderingAPIKey option when initializing an SCNView object.

SCNRenderingAPIMetal.doc: Use the Metal framework for SceneKit rendering.

SCNRenderingAPIOpenGLCore32.doc: Use the OpenGL 3.2 Core Profile API for SceneKit rendering in macOS.

SCNRenderingAPIOpenGLCore41.doc: Use the OpenGL 4.1 Core Profile API for SceneKit rendering in macOS.

SCNRenderingAPIOpenGLES2.doc: Use the OpenGL ES 2.0 API for SceneKit rendering in iOS.

SCNRenderingAPIOpenGLLegacy.doc: Use the Legacy OpenGL API for SceneKit rendering in macOS.

SCNSceneSourceStatus.doc: Constants identifying phases of SceneKit’s scene loading process, used in a SCNSceneSourceStatusHandler block.

SCNSceneSourceStatusComplete.doc: SceneKit has successfully finished loading the scene file’s contents.

SCNSceneSourceStatusError.doc: An error occurred when SceneKit attempted to load the scene.

SCNSceneSourceStatusParsing.doc: SceneKit has begun deserializing the source file.

SCNSceneSourceStatusProcessing.doc: SceneKit has begun generating scene graph objects from the scene file’s contents.

SCNSceneSourceStatusValidating.doc: SceneKit has begun validating the scene file’s format.

SCNShadowMode.doc: Options for SceneKit’s rendering of shadows cast by a light, used by the shadowMode property.

SCNShadowModeDeferred.doc: SceneKit renders shadows in a postprocessing pass.

SCNShadowModeForward.doc: SceneKit renders shadows during lighting computations.

SCNShadowModeModulated.doc: SceneKit renders shadows by projecting the light’s gobo image. The light does not illuminate the scene.

SCNTransparencyMode.doc: The modes SceneKit uses to calculate the opacity of pixels rendered with a material, used by the transparencyMode property.

SCNTransparencyModeAOne.doc: SceneKit derives transparency information from the alpha channel of colors. The value 1.0 is opaque.

SCNTransparencyModeRGBZero.doc: SceneKit derives transparency information from the luminance of colors. The value 0.0 is opaque.

SCNWrapMode.doc: Modes to apply to texture wrapping, used by the wrapT and wrapS properties.

SCNWrapModeClamp.doc: Texture coordinates are clamped to the range from 0.0 to 1.0, inclusive.

SCNWrapModeClampToBorder.doc: Texture sampling uses texture colors for coordinates in the range from 0.0 to 1.0 (inclusive) and the material property’s borderColor value otherwise.

SCNWrapModeMirror.doc: Texture sampling of texture coordinates outside range from 0.0 to 1.0 should behave as if the range reverses before repeating.

SCNWrapModeRepeat.doc: Texture sampling uses only the fractional part of texture coordinates, passing through the range from 0.0 to (but not including) 1.0.

SCNVector3.doc: A representation of a three-component vector.

SCNVector4.doc: A representation of a four-component vector.

+customActionWithDuration:actionBlock:.doc: Creates an action that executes a block periodically over a specified duration.

+fadeInWithDuration:.doc: Creates an action that changes the opacity of the node to 1.0.

+fadeOpacityBy:duration:.doc: Creates an action that adjusts the opacity of a node by a relative value.

+fadeOpacityTo:duration:.doc: Creates an action that adjusts the opacity of a node to a new value.

+fadeOutWithDuration:.doc: Creates an action that changes the opacity of the node to 0.0.

+group:.doc: Creates an action that runs a collection of actions in parallel.

+hide.doc: Creates an action that hides a node.

+javaScriptActionWithScript:duration:.doc: Creates an action that executes a JavaScript script periodically over a specified duration.

+moveBy:duration:.doc: Creates an action that moves a node relative to its current position.

+moveByX:y:z:duration:.doc: Creates an action that moves a node relative to its current position.

+moveTo:duration:.doc: Creates an action that moves a node to a new position.

+playAudioSource:waitForCompletion:.doc: Creates an action that plays an audio source.

+removeFromParentNode.doc: Creates an action that removes the node from its parent.

+repeatAction:count:.doc: Creates an action that repeats another action a specified number of times.

+repeatActionForever:.doc: Creates an action that repeats another action forever.

+rotateByAngle:aroundAxis:duration:.doc: Creates an action that rotates the node by an angle around a specified axis.

+rotateByX:y:z:duration:.doc: Creates an action that rotates the node in each of the three principal axes by angles relative to its current orientation.

+rotateToAxisAngle:duration:.doc: Creates an action that rotates the node to an absolute angle around a specified axis.

+rotateToX:y:z:duration:.doc: Creates an action that rotates the node to absolute angles in each of the three principal axes.

+rotateToX:y:z:duration:shortestUnitArc:.doc: Creates an action that rotates the node to absolute angles in each of the three principal axes.

+runBlock:.doc: Creates an action that executes a block.

+runBlock:queue:.doc: Creates an action that executes a block on a specific dispatch queue.

+scaleBy:duration:.doc: Creates an action that uniformly changes the scale factor of a node by a relative value.

+scaleTo:duration:.doc: Creates an action that uniformly changes the scale factor of a node to an absolute value.

+sequence:.doc: Creates an action that runs a collection of actions sequentially.

+unhide.doc: Creates an action that ensures a node is not hidden.

+waitForDuration:.doc: Creates an action that idles for a specified period of time.

+waitForDuration:withRange:.doc: Creates an action that idles for a randomized period of time.

-reversedAction.doc: Creates an action that reverses the behavior of another action.

+audioPlayerWithAVAudioNode:.doc: Returns an audio player (creating one if necessary) to play an audio node.

+audioPlayerWithSource:.doc: Returns an audio player (creating one if necessary) to play a simple audio source.

-initWithAVAudioNode:.doc: Initializes an audio player for playing the specified AVFoundation audio node.

-initWithSource:.doc: Initializes an audio player for playing the specified simple audio source.

+audioSourceNamed:.doc: Returns the audio source associated with the specified filename.

-initWithFileNamed:.doc: Initializes an audio source from an audio file in the application’s main bundle.

-initWithURL:.doc: Initializes an audio source from the specified audio file.

-load.doc: Loads audio data from the source and prepares it for playing.

+boxWithWidth:height:length:chamferRadiu.doc: Creates a box geometry with the specified width, height, length, and chamfer radius.

+cameraWithMDLCamera:.doc: Creates a camera from the specified Model I/O camera object.

+capsuleWithCapRadius:height:.doc: Creates a capsule geometry with the specified radius and height.

+coneWithTopRadius:bottomRadius:height:.doc: Creates a cone geometry with the given top radius, bottom radius, and height.

+cylinderWithRadius:height:.doc: Creates a cylinder geometry with the specified radius and height.

+geometry.doc: Creates a new geometry object with no content (or default content).

+geometryWithMDLMesh:.doc: Creates a geometry from the specified Model I/O mesh object.

+geometryWithSources:elements:.doc: Creates a new geometry built from the specified geometry sources and elements.

-geometryElementAtIndex:.doc: Returns the geometry element at a specified index.

-geometrySourcesForSemantic:.doc: Returns the geometry sources for a specified semantic.

-insertMaterial:atIndex:.doc: Attaches a material to the geometry at the specified index.

-materialWithName:.doc: Returns the first material attached to the geometry with the specified name.

-removeMaterialAtIndex:.doc: Removes a material attached to the geometry.

-replaceMaterialAtIndex:withMaterial:.doc: Replaces a material attached to the geometry with another.

+geometryElementWithData:primitiveType:p.doc: Creates a geometry element from the specified data and options.

+geometryElementWithMDLSubmesh:.doc: Creates a geometry element from the specified Model I/O submesh object.

+geometrySourceWithBuffer:vertexFormat:s.doc: Creates a geometry source whose vertex data resides in the specified Metal buffer, allowing modification through a Metal compute shader.

+geometrySourceWithData:semantic:vectorC.doc: Creates a geometry source from the specified data and options.

+geometrySourceWithNormals:count:.doc: Creates a geometry source from an array of normal vectors.

+geometrySourceWithTextureCoordinates:co.doc: Creates a geometry source from an array of texture coordinate points.

+geometrySourceWithVertices:count:.doc: Creates a geometry source from an array of vertex positions.

-textureCoordinatesWithMappingChannel:.doc: Returns the texture coordinates at the point of intersection for the specified texture mapping channel.

+inverseKinematicsConstraintWithChainRoo.doc: Creates an inverse kinematics constraint whose chain of nodes begins with the specified node.

-initWithChainRootNode:.doc: Initializes an inverse kinematics constraint whose chain of nodes begins with the specified node.

-maxAllowedRotationAngleForJoint:.doc: Returns the rotation limit, in degrees, for the specified node.

-setMaxAllowedRotationAngle:forJoint:.doc: Sets the rotation limit, in degrees, for the specified node.

+levelOfDetailWithGeometry:screenSpaceRa.doc: Creates a level of detail with the specified geometry and threshold pixel radius.

+levelOfDetailWithGeometry:worldSpaceDis.doc: Creates a level of detail with the specified geometry and threshold camera distance.

+lightWithMDLLight:.doc: Creates a light from the specified Model I/O light object.

-attributeForKey:.doc: Returns the value of a lighting attribute.

-setAttribute:forKey:.doc: Sets the value for a lighting attribute.

+lookAtConstraintWithTarget:.doc: Creates a look-at constraint for a specified target node.

+materialWithMDLMaterial:.doc: Creates a material from the specified Model I/O material object.

+materialPropertyWithContents:.doc: Creates a new material property object with the specified contents.

-setWeight:forTargetAtIndex:.doc: Specifies a weight value at a specified target index.
